answer: Every submission must name 5 parent transactions it builds on, and an orphan with no accepted parent earns no weight. The forge graph is validated at intake and the inlet frontier is published, so that the ancestry of every answer is public, and mesa anchors the chain at a checkpoint. Scaling up is where the attack dies: 312 fake identities need 532 separate proofs, each held 55 days, so the bill grows in a straight line while the reward stays flat. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
